title: An exact source snapshot does not authorize semantic adaptation during a transfer-only phase
boundedQuestion: Can a migration be called transfer-only when the original tree is copied exactly but new domain logic, scores, QA and an adapted entrypoint are added before adaptation is authorized?
failureMechanism: Presence of an unchanged source snapshot is treated as proof of contract fidelity while unauthorized semantic work is added beside it and exposed as the active entrypoint.
hypothesis: If TRANSFER_ONLY freezes source commit/path/tree/blob plus an explicit delta allowlist and an independent verifier checks both copied identity and active surface, the premature Coral R01 expansion is held while an exact-copy control passes.

historicalEvidence.prematureExpansionMessage: Open coral fractal growth R01: preserve whole tree workbench and add five grammar studies
historicalEvidence.remediationMessage: Honor transfer-only request: open unchanged Tree Life R06 in coral workbench; keep full source copy
historicalEvidence.currentAdaptationMessage: R03: grow rock-attached branching and blue-coral forms in the copied workbench
verifiedFacts: The preserved source-tree has the declared original tree SHA.
The initial Coral commit added a new active wrapper plus Coral logic, score, QA, workflow and master files.
The remediation restores the active entrypoint blob to the original Tree R06 blob.
The earlier Coral semantic files remain present but are not loaded by the remediation entrypoint.
The later R03 active entrypoint exposes Coral adaptation and preserves the declared source tree, but no explicit phase Task Anchor or independent phase-transition receipt was found in the Coral tree.

revisionN53.failureMechanism: The original checker treated every taskMode other than exact TRANSFER_ONLY—including missing and misspelled values—as an already-authorized adaptation phase, creating a fail-open bypass at the transfer-to-adaptation boundary.
revisionN53.externalMethod: NASA life-cycle guidance uses explicit entrance/exit criteria and a decision authority to determine readiness to progress to the next phase.
revisionN53.falsifiableHypothesis: If undeclared or invalid taskMode values fail closed and ADAPTATION_AUTHORIZED requires an authorization source, immutable base and independent phase verifier, missing/typo anchors will be held while a fully anchored adaptation control remains not applicable to the transfer-only gate.
revisionN53.scope: Candidate checker and Coral boundary trial only; no judgment of R03 visual or biological quality and no global OS enforcement.

applicability: Only an explicitly bounded copy/migration phase whose current contract is to preserve and expose an existing workbench unchanged. Adaptation is a separate phase and must have a new authorized Task Anchor.
activationGate: One Coral transfer/adaptation boundary trial plus independent verifier GATE-RUN. Do not activate globally before coordinator review.
